title: Craft hovered over New Underwood reservoir dam
place_text: New Underwood Lake Reservoir, near November 1 and November 5, South Dakota

tellings.quote: it's a Pythagorean triangle from November 1 to November 5 over to new Lake Reservoir and back to November 1 control I believe based on that position of new Reservoir Dam that's where that craft was it was over that body of water

plain: Mario Woods is a former guard at nuclear missile sites in South Dakota who says he was abducted by a UFO. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1977 a craft hovered over the dam at New Underwood Lake Reservoir, a spot he places within a triangle formed by two missile sites code-named November 1 and November 5. If he is right, the craft was sitting right next to nuclear weapons sites.
